title: Payday Buttered Noodles
description: A comforting old-school buttered noodles recipe inspired by a social media post.

ingredients.item: Splash of hot sauce (optional, as per the post)

steps: Heat a hot skillet with a little oil. Add shaved beef steak and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add diced shallot, minced garlic, dried parsley, red pepper flakes, creole seasoning, and butter to the skillet. Continue cooking until the shallots are translucent and the beef is cooked through.
Meanwhile, boil water with a pinch of salt. Add pasta and cook for five minutes, ensuring it remains al dente. Drain and set aside, reserving some pasta water.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet with the beef and vegetables. Pour in Parmesan cheese, pasta water, and evaporated milk. Stir to combine everything thoroughly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for about eight minutes, allowing flavors to meld.
Remove from heat. Top with additional Parmesan cheese and a splash of hot sauce if desired. Serve immediately.
notes:
Feel free to adjust the spice levels with more or less red pepper flakes and hot sauce to suit your taste.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AAuxefb5U/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 600 kcal · Fat 25g · Saturated fat 10g · Unsaturated fat 15g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 50mg · Sodium 800mg · Carbs 80g · Fiber 4g · Sugar 8g · Protein 30g

healthy: Shaved steak gives plenty of protein.
not_healthy: Butter, Parmesan and evaporated milk add saturated fat.
Creole seasoning, Parmesan and salt add sodium.
A pound of white pasta is mostly refined carbs.
